build: marketops 0.1.0 (serverInfo reported by the deployment under test)

measured_under.note: the client was run against a dedicated MarketOps MCP server on an unused loopback port, with an isolated CODEX_HOME; the exchange was captured at the byte level by a local TCP relay

installed_projection.reason: the package was installed and enabled (see plugin_install_verified), but no client session was observed loading the Skill from the installed location. Copying onto disk is not reading; the two are recorded separately for that reason

mcp_connected.detail: initialize and notifications/initialized completed; tools/list returned a catalog

auth_verified.detail: the client's own auth path succeeded and the same request with a wrong token was refused with 401, with no session created

tool_catalog_verified.detail: the names the client received were compared against the deployment's catalog: the difference in one direction was empty, and the withheld set was explained by role and by absent capability

read_flow_verified.reason: the client's model turn could not be completed in this environment, so no read use case was really invoked by the client; the MCP handshake was already complete when the turn failed, and only the handshake is claimed here

write_flow_verified.reason: same as read_flow_verified: not attempted in this run

notification_push_verified.reason: not attempted in this run; this is a client-side capability question that a handshake does not answer

plugin_install_verified.detail: the client's own marketplace-add and plugin-add path installed the package into an isolated client home; the installed copy was then compared against the source file by file, and the difference was empty
